# Animal Image Classification

An end-to-end Computer Vision pipeline to download, preprocess, train, and test deep learning models for multi-class animal image classification.

---

## 📌 Project Overview

This repository provides a modular workflow for image-based animal classification:
- Automated data downloading and preprocessing (renaming, organizing).
- Model training routines (standard neural network & OpenCV/transfer learning pipelines).
- Inference and testing scripts for evaluating on unseen animal images.

---

## 📁 Repository Structure

```text
├── 1.jpg               # Sample test image
├── cv_train.py         # Computer Vision / OpenCV-based training pipeline
├── download.py         # Script to download and fetch dataset images
├── rename.py           # Preprocessing script to clean and rename images
├── test.py             # Inference/evaluation script on new images
├── train.py            # Main model training script
├── .gitignore          # Git ignore rules for cached models & dataset folders
└── README.md           # Project documentation

```
